headline: Executive order closed federal executive departments and agencies for half of the day on Christmas Eve, Thursday, December 24, 1998.
what_it_does: This order closed federal executive departments and agencies for part of the workday on Thursday, December 24, 1998, the day before the Christmas holiday. The title describes it as a half-day closing. No summary was provided, so details such as exact hours or which workers had to stay on the job are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal government employees in executive departments and agencies
who_it_affects.how: Many likely received half of December 24, 1998 off work, though the title does not say which employees, if any, were required to keep working.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the public who use federal offices
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices were closed for part of December 24, 1998, so in-person services were likely limited that day.
